description: Build an index over a word sequence so repeated shortest-distance requests can be answered efficiently. Example 1: in [practice, makes, perfect, coding, makes], the distance from coding to practice is 3. Example 2: the distance from coding to makes is 1. Constraints: requested words exist in the input and the two query words differ.
intuition: For each word, its sorted occurrence positions are enough to locate the closest pair.

brute_force.approach: Scan all positions of one word and compare them with every position of the other.

optimal.approach: Store sorted position lists and advance two pointers to the nearest matching occurrences.

edge_cases: Repeated occurrences may make a later pair closer than the first pair.
The two queried words are guaranteed to be distinct.
